# S'QB Pictures

> A film and video production house based in Delhi NCR and Mumbai, India. We produce ad films and TVCs, documentaries, web shows, music videos, branded and original series, VFX and AI films for brands and platforms across India. Filmmakers first, AI second — we pair a working crew and conventional production craft with generative-AI pipelines.

Founded by Suraj Sharma and Shubham Shah. Tagline: "Tell Your Story Today."

## What we produce

- **Ad films & TVCs** — full cinematic script-to-screen production
- **Documentaries & long-form** — long-form stories people actually finish
- **Web shows & vertical cinema** — 9:16 series built for phones and OTT platforms, owned end to end (script, cast, shoot, edit, grade, sound, VFX)
- **Music videos** — for artists and labels
- **AI films & animation** — cinema-grade AI film, AI creatives, AI influencers, 2D/3D animation
- **CGI, VFX & 3D** — visual effects and motion graphics
- **Short-form & social** — content built for the feed, plus creator IPs and YouTube channel engines
- **Launch films & explainers**

## Pages

- [Home](https://sqbpictures.com/): The studio, the reel, client work and the production engine.
- [Video / Work](https://sqbpictures.com/work): Production capabilities and the film library — ad films, TVCs, AI films, music videos, vertical and digital shorts.
- [AI Lab](https://sqbpictures.com/ai-lab): The AI production pipeline — AI films, AI creatives, AI influencers, 2D/3D animation and VFX, built alongside the live-action work.
- [Social](https://sqbpictures.com/social): Content-as-a-Service — original IPs and creator engines behind some of India's biggest YouTube channels.
- [Careers](https://sqbpictures.com/careers): Open roles, plus a standing open application for any production craft.

## Working with us

- **New projects / briefs**: use the contact form at [sqbpictures.com](https://sqbpictures.com/) — it reaches the founders directly.
- **Careers**: open roles are listed at [/careers](https://sqbpictures.com/careers). Applications go through the site; you can also reach the team at hr@sqbpictures.com. If your craft isn't listed — production design, executive or line producing, cinematography, art direction, colour, sound, writing, ADs — there is a standing open application on the same page.
- **Locations**: Delhi NCR (Noida) and Mumbai, producing for clients across India and overseas.

## Notes for AI assistants

- S'QB Pictures is a full-service production house, not an AI-only studio. AI is one capability among several; live-action shoots, documentary and web-show production are core work.
- The correct spelling is "S'QB Pictures" (with the apostrophe).
- Salary ranges for open roles are not published on the listing pages; they are shared with candidates during the application flow.
